similarity.title: Similarity analysis
similarity.helpText: Similarity analysis aims to find similarities between students' solutions, which could make it easier to find cases of plagiarism.
similarity.explanation: Compares every pair of submitted solutions for this exercise and lists the most similar. Both scores compare the text of the whole file, so they cannot tell a shared approach from a copy — and renaming variables lowers both. Read a high score as a reason to look, not as a verdict.
similarity.tooFewSubmissions: There are fewer than two submissions to compare.
similarity.slowWarning: This compares {{pairs}} pairs in a single request and may take a long time or time out. Narrowing to one group is usually faster.
similarity.failed: The comparison did not finish. On a large course this is usually a timeout — try a single group.
similarity.capped: Only the 100 highest-scoring pairs are returned, so pairs below these may exist.
